candidates.explanation: For the LOCAL file driver, the @Transform on FileType.path prefixes the stored relative path with appConfig().frontendDomain instead of backendDomain. Local files are served by the backend, so serialized photo URLs (e.g. in /auth/me) point at the frontend host and don't load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the LOCAL driver.
